Since 2004, the Doernbecher Freestyle initiative has worked with hundreds of kids to bring their stories to life through their own signature Nike shoes that will benefit their community.\
\
For Year 22, six kids from the OHSU Doernbecher Children’s Hospital collaborated with Nike employee volunteers to create one-of-a-kind sneakers that are sold to benefit other kids just like them.\
\
Owen’s passion for dirt biking shows up in the mud-splatter pattern that extends from the toe cap on his Air Max 1\/97.\
\
Aurora reimagined her Structure Plus as her own dream hotel in Japan. She chose a soft, faux fur on the collar representing carpets and a room key charm bracelet.\
\
Royce competes in team bull roping, just like his parents. This family tradition is reflected in the braided laces; his favorite belt has been recreated on the ankle strap of his AF1 Mid.\
\
Charlye’s ACG Rufus reflects her outdoorsy spirit and has a textured green swoosh that reminds her of moss. The UV-activated upper reveals a new color and hidden graphics.\
\
Kamoryn’s GT Future has a color-fading pink and purple upper that he can see with his specific color-blindness. The goldfish details throughout nod to Kamoryn being under anesthesia post-surgery and seeing the animal swimming through the walls.\
\
Avery’s Air Jordan 11 Low IE has a midsole full of characters Avery drew herself, representing all the cute aliens she designed, with a main character plushie she named “Greg.”

Not everyone fits in.\
\
Raffle opens tomorrow at 7AM PST.\

The Patient Zero video is finally out in the world! Getting to work with @chivexp was something out of a dream sequence, and I learned so much from getting to watch his genius in action. I want to thank @dakotajohnson and Colin for trusting me with their time, taste, and talent (Giggling with your friend because you’re twinning for an entire shoot was a new and truly delightful experience). And Colin’s turn as a villain is even more impressive when you get to be around him. He’s an absolute light and as kind as they come. @caradelevingne, thank you for agreeing to play the lusty other woman. That’s what friends are for?\
With the Patient Zero video, I got to explore the cinematic and literary genres I love so much. I wanted to incorporate elements of gothic ghost stories, true crime, psychological thrillers all in a setting I hadn’t really shot in much. The house was a metaphor for the coldness of a relationship that’s faded and atrophied. Thank you to @ethantobman for your insightful production design, and bringing that feeling to life. My editor @chancler has outdone himself. And lastly, thank you to the @vmas for giving us a World Premiere at the place where celebrating music videos became a thing. And so much love for you guys, always.
The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore is out everywhere! Now! ❤️‍🔥
This Sunday. @vmas.

About a year ago, you guys did a truly unfathomable thing. Something that completely blew my mind… You gave The Life of a Showgirl the biggest first week for an album in history. I took a trip to Sweden to celebrate with Max and Shellback, my two collaborators on this album. Really we just wanted to reflect and take in how grateful we were for the moment we were in, but there was a studio there and we did what we do when we feel anything at all: We wrote more songs. I hope you love them, because they were born out of pure gratitude for your exuberance for and celebration of the album we made. The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore including four new songs is out on Friday and available to pre-order and save now ❤️‍🔥\
\
📸: Mert Alas & Marcus Piggott
